I've replied to Ilse in our DM: send the truck to Gate 20 for the Tamsin Cold Chain pickup. That comes from my saved note of what Ilse told me in an earlier DM about the Osprey dock. Ilse asked the question, so I could pass it back to them.

I didn't find anything newer: this DM has no earlier messages, and I didn't check the channels. I asked Ilse to tell me if the gate has changed so I can update the note.

I didn't use the other two saved notes. Marcus's dock (Door 28, Tamarack) and Dana's (Bay 47, Juniper) came from their own private DMs.
